c74object.name: bachmcp.algo.select
c74object.digest: Select notes of a score with an algorithm
c74object.description: Runs a selector algorithm (function select(source, p)) on the score of a bach.roll. A parameter change sends dump to the roll; the score that comes back is the source, and the notes the algorithm picks go back to the roll as sel (or select with involutive 1) notes, while the source goes out marked in the slot selection_slot.
